properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for verifying application level encryption is applied
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to verify Data is encrypted by the application before it is transferred to a storage service. This way, even if someone has obtained access to the storage service or the file system used by the application for storing data,  it is protected against unauthorized access.
